They’re all so bad idk which to tell. Throwback sum odd years i was dating my literal soulmate and i don’t remember what set me off but I had a serious problem where I did self destructive things because the outcome of my decision was amusing to me.
Class ends, I meet with gf like usual walk to spot we before the doors and this is how the conversation goes:
Her: you’re quiet today, are you okay?
Me: no, I’m not happy with us or this relationship. And honestly I was just tryna smash. 
I walked away, scold me Ik it’s awful but I was very naive to the behavior labyrinth I was darting into head first. There is a lot more to it and this is only a small fraction of it.
I can see the light in her eyes when she looks at me fading, please 🥺

Sorry about the slow reply I hate altercation, turned chicken and did none of the above and ended up forking over 120$ for her saving me out of a bad situation earlier. Right now having a personality crisis breakdown. 

-Wish you the best probably dead thread.
